faqs.q: Why do snakes turn up around Chapmanville stone walls and woodpiles?
faqs.a: Rock walls, woodpiles, and mine-bench edges shelter mice, and snakes — mostly harmless rat snakes, copperheads on the rocky ground — follow the food. It is illegal to kill any snake in the wild in West Virginia; our crew captures problem snakes non-lethally and liberates them at the site of capture.
